description: Sensor data log format for each received sensor message (IMU or GPS). Unused fields are left blank.

notes.gps_ts: Last GPS time received in hh:mm:ss format.
notes.gps_update: 1 only when new and valid GPS data is received.
notes.imu_update: 1 only when new and valid IMU data is received.
notes.lat/lon: Set in degrees, from microdegree values.
notes.speed_kmph: Converted from knots if available, else -1.
